cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.definition: straw man은 실제로는 아무도 하지 않은 주장이나 논리를 약하게 바꿔 세운 뒤 반박하는 수법이다. 상대방의 실제 주장이 아니라 straw man을 반박하는 것은 잘못된 논증이다.
cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.gloss: 누구도 실제로 주장하지 않은 논리를 세워 쉽게 반박할 수 있게 하는 논법.

cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.definition: Recurso que atribui ao adversário uma posição mais fraca ou extrema do que a defendida, para depois atacar essa posição equivocada.
cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.gloss: Versão exagerada ou distorcida de um argumento, criada para ser facilmente refutada.

cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.definition: การแต่งข้อโต้แย้งที่อีกฝ่ายไม่ได้พูดและทำให้ง่ายต่อการโต้แย้ง เพื่อให้ดูเหมือนตีความความคิดของอีกฝ่ายผิด
cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.gloss: ข้อโต้แย้งที่ผู้พูดไม่ได้กล่าวแต่นำมาโจมตี

cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.definition: Sahibinin savunmadığı, çarpıtılmış ya da aşırı genişletilmiş bir fikri kolayca reddedilecek biçimde sunmak. Bu yöntem, asıl savın güçlü olup olmadığını göstermez.
cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.gloss: Kolayca çürütülebilmesi için savın bozulmuş biçimini yeniden ortaya koyma.

cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.definition: Argumen yang attributed kepada orang lain tetapi sebenarnya tidak pernah diucapkan, sengaja dibuat agar mudah diruntuhkan.
cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.gloss: Argumen yang tidak dibuat siapa pun dan sengaja dibentuk agar mudah dijatuhkan.

cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.translation: Jadi kamu ingin menghentikan seluruh proyek merupakan argumen boneka jerami; pembicara hanya mengatakan jadwalnya terlalu singkat.
“Bütün projeyi bırakmak istiyorsun” ifadesi, konuşmacının yalnızca takvimin kısa olduğunu söylemesini çürütmüyordu; bu bir kukla adam argümanıydı.
การตีความว่าผู้พูดต้องยกเลิกโครงการทั้งหมดเป็นหุ่นฟาง เพราะผู้พูดเพียงบอกว่ากำหนดการสั้นเกินไป
Dizer que você queria abandonar todo o projeto foi um homem de palha, pois o orador havia falado apenas que o cronograma era curto.
프로젝트 전체를 중단하라는 말은 straw man이었고, 발표자는 일정만 짧다고 했을 뿐이었다.
プロジェクト全体を取りやめたいと言ったとするのは、ストローマンです。話者は予定が短いと言っただけでした。

cdf6103f6bacbb1d82f2b640dbd7382650e115e7.text: So you want to drop the whole project was a straw man; the speaker had only said the schedule was short.

cdfe9ddcdb4eb9bb26e41133e75f74fa3bb26436.definition: Không bằng 0; hệ số a trong ax + b = 0 phải khác không thì mới tuyến tính đúng nghĩa.
Not equal to zero. Division by zero is not allowed.
cdfe9ddcdb4eb9bb26e41133e75f74fa3bb26436.gloss: Not equal to zero. Division by zero is not allowed.

cdfe9ddcdb4eb9bb26e41133e75f74fa3bb26436.text: a must be a non-zero constant.
cdfe9ddcdb4eb9bb26e41133e75f74fa3bb26436.translation: a phải là hằng số khác không.
